title: Frost DK / Destro / Disc vs Turbo
summary: Their Enhancement Shaman holds two answers. That is the whole plan — reach him and he does not come back.

sections.title: Two answers is the shortest list in this document
sections.body: Counts: Warrior 8, Resto 3, Enhancement 2. The Enhancement Shaman holds Astral Shift and a trinket. Once both are gone he has nothing until a 90s cooldown returns, and his healer has three of his own. Kill him. The Warrior's eight make him a target you cannot finish and Rallying Cry blunts anything you send at either of them.

sections.title: Opener — get the Resto out of the go

steps.note: On the Resto Shaman. Free, and he has no way out of it.
45s silence on the Resto as the Fear breaks.
On the Warlock. 2 min — not every go.

sections.title: The go — aligned on Pillar of Frost

steps.note: 45s. The term everything else lines up to.
90s. Every second Pillar, not every one.
60s. Align it or lose half the window.
60s. On the Warrior, so he cannot peel.

sections.title: What the Enhancement Shaman answers with — both of them

steps.note: 120s. After this he has nothing at all.

sections.title: Two things this plan cannot assume
sections.body: Banish does not work on players — it is demons and elementals only, so it is not cross-CC here whatever the tooltip suggests. And Shadowfury and Howl of Terror share a choice node: your Warlock has one of them, not both, and the opener above assumes Fear rather than either.
